the_heights.description: The Heights is currently a regular map in rotation, but it was an event map during the SFOTH Event.

knight_the_heights.name: Knight
knight_the_heights.description: The Knight was an enemy that appeared in The Heights during the SFOTH Event.

boomer_1.name: Boomer 1
boomer_1.description: The Boomer 1 was an enemy that exploded upon its death, stunning nearby towers in its radius. It was a fairly strong enemy with an average speed.

stone_viking.name: Stone Viking
stone_viking.description: The Stone Viking was an enemy that appeared exclusively in The Heights as part of the SFOTH Event.

crystalite.name: Crystalite
crystalite.description: The Crystalite was an enemy that appeared exclusively in The Heights as part of the SFOTH Event. It had the same speed as the Normal Boss and Necromancer.

swordmaster.name: Swordmaster
swordmaster.description: The Swordmaster wore a red cloak and pants. Painted on its cloak appeared to be a necklace. It had green skin, light red legs and a dark red shirt.

gravekeeper.name: Gravekeeper
gravekeeper.description: The Gravekeeper was considered to be the first major boss of the game to appear. It was the final enemy that appeared in Easy mode.

ultra_mystery.name: Ultra Mystery
ultra_mystery.description: The Ultra Mystery was a mysterious enemy that was quite fast, being slightly slower than the Ninja, and it also had average health for its debut.

uber_mystery.name: Uber Mystery
uber_mystery.description: The Uber Mystery was a mysterious enemy that was quite fast, having nearly the same speed as the Quick, but it also had low health for its debut.

ninja.name: Ninja
ninja.description: The Ninja was an enemy that could not be attacked by towers without hidden detection. Without hidden detection, the Ninja was a nuisance.

swarm.description: The Swarm, in-game referred to as Swarm 1 despite there only being one Swarm enemy, was a four-legged enemy that was spawned from the Carrier when it died.

tank_2.name: Tank 2
tank_2.description: The Tank 2 was a stronger form of the Tank 1. It had the same speed as the Tank 1 while also having much more health than it.

controlled.name: Controlled
controlled.description: The Controlled appeared to be a normal enemy with average speed and low health for its debut.

shrike_crystal.name: Shrike Crystal
shrike_crystal.description: The Shrike Crystal was a crystal that appeared once a Controlled was killed. The crystal stunned nearby towers and were resistant to explosions.

rusted.name: Rusted
rusted.description: The Rusted was an enemy with an average speed and more health than the Chained. Though it was not considered a boss, it had high health for its debut.

tombstone.name: Tombstone
tombstone.description: The Tombstone was an immobile enemy spawned by the Gravekeeper. It must be destroyed for the match to end and function essentially like an enemy.

frozen_premega.name: Frozen
frozen_premega.description: It had average speed (about the same as the Normal) and had the same amount of health as the Chained. It was immune to the Freezer's basic freeze.

deep_freeze_premega.name: Deep Freeze
deep_freeze_premega.description: The Deep Freeze was an ice elemental enemy. Compared to the Frozen, the Deep Freeze was slightly slower, but it had more health.

frost_hero_premega.name: Frost Hero
frost_hero_premega.description: The Frost Hero was the final enemy to appear on Insane mode. It had more health than the Gravekeeper.

polluted_wasteland.name: Polluted Wasteland
polluted_wasteland.description: Polluted Wasteland was a map that had recently been through a nuclear disaster. On Fallen and Golden modes, some of the enemies were replaced with nuclear variants.

radioactive.name: Radioactive
radioactive.description: The Radioactive was an enemy that appeared exclusively in Polluted Wasteland Fallen mode and was a replacement for the Heavy in Polluted Wasteland.
